title: William Ackman: Everything You Need to Know About Finance and Investing in Under an Hour | Big Think
summary: A Big Think talk in which hedge-fund manager William Ackman goes through the basics of finance and investing in under an hour. It is pitched as a crash course on the most important concepts.
why: HN recommends it to beginners as a quick, clear overview of finance and investing fundamentals.

quote.text: An excellent crash course for the most critical concepts.
